# Passwords & Menu Codes

Default passcodes from manuals. Rental shops sometimes change them. Full details and sources are on each maker's `_common` page.

## By manufacturer

| Maker | Code | What it unlocks | How to enter |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chauvet Pro | **2323** | Offset / Zero Adjust (pan/tilt/zoom home trim) and protected settings | Hold **MENU** until "Password" → UP changes digit, DOWN next digit → ENTER |
| Chauvet Pro | **UP, DOWN, UP, DOWN, ENTER** | Control-panel (menu access) lock | Press the sequence on the locked display |
| Chauvet Pro | `admin` / `admin` | Web interface (PXL Bar 16, Maverick MK3 Spot) | Browser to the fixture IP |
| Robe | **7623** | Service menu (fixed, can't be changed) | Enter when the service menu asks |
| Robe | `robe` / `2479` | REAP web portal | Service → Reset Web Password restores it |
| Robe | slide gesture | Buttons locked | On the ROBE logo screen: ESCAPE → NEXT → ENTER → PREV → ESCAPE (clockwise) |
| Claypaky | **1234** | Advanced menu (firmware, calibration, factory default, menu locking); also the default Menu Locking code | Advanced menu → enter code |
| Elation | **050** | Service / calibration (Proteus series) | Enter each time the menu asks |
| Elation | **011** | Restore factory defaults (Proteus series) | — |
| Elation | **038** | Lamp-hours reset (Smarty Hybrid) | MODE/ESC → Information → Time Information → LampTime Password |
| GLP | **Mode + Enter + Up** | Key lock (X4 Bar) | Press together |
| Martin | none found | — | — |
